newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market light at $64.00- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market light at $64.00- USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed on 600 slaughter steers and 300 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date, 80,800 head confirmed including 18,300 head or about 23% previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1275 lbs 64.00.
Dressed basis - Few Select with end Choice 1250 lbs 103.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975 lbs 64.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1250 lb heifers, heiferettes 64.00.
Confirmed - 900 last week - Holiday last year - 3,200
Wk to date - 80,800 last week - 14,300 last year - 16,400
